Title: TOM: AH: Q: Akhenaten, The Sun Pharoh (Mummy)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Akhenaten, The Sun Pharoh (Mummy) (Ally) 4 Pool
Unique Ally with 3 life.
3 hand damage, 1 bleed.
Ahkenaten may play cards requiring basic necromancy as a vampire with a
capacity of 3. Any cost in blood is paid with his life. If a card would
give him blood, give him life. If he is burned, shuffle him into your
library. If he is in combat with a Follower of Set, any damage he
inflicts is aggrivated.
(D) Burn Kherebutu to burn a Follower of Set controlled by your prey.
^^^^^^^^^

Shouldn't Akhenaten have to burn himself instead of Kherebutu?

(If not, then is that (D) action directed at the controller
of Kherebutu or the controller ot the Setite? :-)
